name: Basic service relationship
hint: The simplest type: the provider delivers and the consumer consumes, with little shared work.

name: Cooperative service relationship
hint: Provider and consumer share information and work together to improve, but stay separate parties.

name: Collaborative service relationship
hint: A close partnership with shared goals, where both sides jointly work toward them.

name: Sponsor
hint: Authorizes the budget for service consumption.

name: Customer
hint: Defines the requirements for a service and takes responsibility for the outcomes.

name: User
hint: Uses the services.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
hint: A documented agreement between a provider and a consumer on the services required and the expected level of service.

name: Incident
hint: An unplanned interruption to a service, or a drop in its quality.

name: Event
hint: Any change of state that matters for managing a service or other item.

name: Release
hint: A version of a service or other item, or a group of them, made available for use.

name: Reliability
hint: The ability to perform the intended function consistently, for a stated time, under stated conditions.

name: Observability
hint: The ability to understand what is happening inside a system from the data it produces.

name: Service request
hint: A request from a user for something agreed as a normal part of the service, such as access.

name: Problem
hint: A cause, or potential cause, of one or more incidents.

hint: A problem that has been analysed but not resolved.
